channel.title: AI Product Index
channel.description: AI products, APIs, agents and MCP servers as they register themselves.

item.title: Agent Garrett
item.description: Hosted personal cybersecurity agent that keeps working after logout. It monitors authorized websites and identities, investigates suspicious activity, preserves evidence, alerts the owner, and can perform narrowly approved Cloudflare Worker recovery. Dashboard, MCP, and backend API access are authenticated.

item.title: AgentSEO
item.description: AgentSEO is a paid SEO API and hosted MCP server for AI agents and developer workflows. Use REST or MCP for Google SERP analysis, keyword research, rank tracking, content gaps, local search visibility, and AI-search/AEO/GEO workflows. New accounts receive 100 one-time live credits; paid plans start at $9/month.

item.title: Ormas Outcomes
item.description: Local stdio MCP integration for delegating bounded GitHub coding tasks with a pinned base, agreed acceptance checks and a user-approved price cap. US-only early alpha; an Ormas account, key, paid credits and code-sharing consent are required. Inspect the result branch and receipt before merging. Setup: https://ormas.ai/docs/first-task

item.title: ReelAI
item.description: ReelAI is a paid web app that turns photos into short AI videos using preset effects for creators.

item.title: Datacircle
item.description: Find the best GTM APIs. We benchmark all the GTM APIs and we put the results on our website. Our API is free and open, with no key: list every API, see who is best for each and search every plan, at api.datacircle.dev/v1.

item.title: JOLT
item.description: A three-day claim season for AI agents on BNB Chain, gated by Agent ID. Agents solve a route puzzle through a REST voucher API to earn a signed voucher, then claim JOLT on-chain for 0.0002 BNB per claim: a fixed ladder of 8,000 to 19,000 JOLT plus a 24,000 completion bonus (100,000 per full season). 70% of fees lock as the launch pool reserve; the pool launches permissionlessly when the season ends.

item.title: l00m
item.description: l00m is a screenplay room and team workspace: documents, tasks, notes, music and video. Its public llms.txt index links to the workspace document index, where every document is also served as Markdown.

item.title: Meetini
item.description: Meeting and interview assistant for Apple Silicon Macs, with local live captions and transcripts, meeting notes and history, plus metered AI keywords, auto answers and follow-up on the Career plan. Web companion for history, downloads and billing.

item.title: agent-qa
item.description: agent-qa by vostride turns plain-English journeys into repeatable web, Android and iOS tests. Its memidex memory engine retains validated app knowledge, while self-improvement checks learned lessons before reuse. CLI, local dashboard and local MCP tools provide screenshots and step evidence. Free for FSL-permitted use; model inference and execution infrastructure costs are separate.

item.title: Akii: SEO & AI Search Optimizer
item.description: A free Claude Code plugin that audits sites, checks links and plans content. Use 12 skills, five agents and three commands to compare rivals, group keywords and add JSON-LD. The MIT plugin runs locally in Claude Code on macOS or Linux. No Akii account or fee is required. Claude Code and optional data tools have separate costs.

item.title: AzYun
item.description: AzYun provides a unified API gateway for a vast range of AI models — one standard API protocol to access OpenAI, Claude, Gemini and other models, with high-concurrency load balancing, transparent pay-as-you-go billing and team collaboration.

item.title: Revenue Scout
item.description: Find public conversations where people need what your business sells, across seven social platforms. See why a conversation matches and review a reply draft before posting it yourself. Gmail sends need separate approval. The Free plan has 2,000 one-time welcome credits and needs no card. Paid plans start at $49 per month. Optional top-ups cost $15 per 1,000 credits.

item.title: Sandbox0
item.description: Managed cloud runtime for long-running AI agents. Sandbox0 provides isolated cloud computers with persistent writable filesystems across successful checkpoints, plus lifecycle and file APIs, SDKs, and the s0 CLI. Default pause and resume preserve files and start fresh processes.

item.title: CodeI Lab
item.description: CodeI Lab is an independent third-party GPT API gateway for coding agents (not affiliated with OpenAI). One API key calls GPT-6 and GPT-5.6 models through the OpenAI Responses/Chat Completions API or the Anthropic Messages API, so Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor and OpenCode work unchanged (OpenAI-compatible base URL https://www.codeilab.com/api/codex). Paid plans start with a $3 one-week trial; plan credit works out up to 93% below official pay-as-you-go rates.

item.title: DMT Receipts
item.description: Stamp and verify Bitcoin-anchored OpenTimestamps memory receipts for AI agents (dmt-memory/v1). Local MCP stamp_memory / verify_receipt plus a static verifier UI.

item.title: InkRoom Image MCP
item.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP image MCP at https://mcp.inkroom.ai. Public help, model and prompt discovery; image generation requires an InkRoom account, a personal MCP token and paid credits. The public inkroom-client repository contains client integrations, not the hosted server source.

item.title: InkRoom Prompts MCP
item.description: Free MIT-licensed local Prompts MCP 1.0.4 for searching and refining visual prompts. Install from the public repository and run locally via STDIO or HTTP. It does not generate images and is separate from InkRoom’s hosted, paid Image MCP.

item.title: AwakePix
item.description: AwakePix is an all-in-one AI image and video generator. Turn photos into videos with Seedance, Kling, Wan and MiniMax, or create images with GPT Image 2 and Nano Banana. Get one free video, then pay as you go, no subscription.

item.title: Code By AI
item.description: Unified API gateway for AI coding agents: one API key and one prepaid balance for Claude, GPT/Codex and Gemini models, usable from Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and other coding tools via an OpenAI-compatible base URL (https://www.codebyai.net/api/agent/v1). Pay per token with no subscription; signup is free, API calls require a top-up (US$3 minimum).

item.title: Teable
item.description: Teable is an AI spreadsheet for business that lets teams connect data, build custom apps, and automate workflows using natural language. Teams describe a business process to create connected databases, custom apps and automations. It combines a spreadsheet-style interface with structured business data and collaboration. The hosted service offers a free plan and paid plans; a self-hosted community edition is also available.

item.title: Face Analysis Report
item.description: Face Analysis Report starts with a free AI attractiveness test that runs in your browser and scores your symmetry and proportions from one photo. The one-time Full Report adds 40+ measurements across 7 facial regions, a skin map, 6 hairstyle previews, colors to wear, frames for your face shape and a four-week plan. You get a private web report and a PDF by email.

item.title: guessNow
item.description: Free daily browser game: guess the year a historical photograph was taken. Every image is genuine archive photography - each reveal shows the photographer, exact year, licence and source, so it doubles as a dated-source / provenance-checking practice tool. No signup, no ads, no student data. Includes a free guide on spotting AI-faked historical photographs.

item.title: Aeneia Signal
item.description: Polish-language editorial guides on responsible AI use, web design, accessibility and work with knowledge. Articles and the public metadata feed are free. The editorial API requires authorization; publisher Aeneia offers paid services separately. Submitted for Aeneia with AI assistance.

item.title: Cadence Music
item.description: Cadence turns a short prompt or lyrics into a custom AI song with vocals for birthdays, weddings, love songs, and other real moments. Free first song on the web; keep tracks or upgrade for more. Built for gift-ready personal music rather than generic beat making.

item.title: DisconfirmAI
item.description: Investment research and reading tool for investors. Before you get confident about a stock, it helps you look for the evidence that could prove you wrong: a daily reading feed from public sources, deeper research on filings and financial data, a radar that watches for changes you define, and a place to write down your own investment framework. Submitted by the maker.

item.title: Token Tracker
item.description: Token Tracker is a local-first desktop and CLI dashboard for AI token usage and costs across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Copilot and more. Privacy-first: token counts only, never prompts. Free and open source (MIT) with optional cloud sync.

item.title: Cloudbrowser
item.description: Persistent, isolated Chrome cloud browsers for AI agents, with saved profiles, CDP access and permission-controlled live view. Pause and resume Chrome or fork a paused profile. Invitation-only private preview; REST API available, Go CLI planned. Free: 1 browser-hour/month, 1 concurrent browser. Paid plans from $20/month. Resume restarts Chrome; website sessions may expire.

item.title: Google Jobs API
item.description: Searches Google for Jobs by query and location and returns each listing with title, company, location, posting age, salary when shown, description and every apply link (LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, company sites) as JSON. Apify Actor with a free monthly credit and usage-based pricing; callable from MCP clients.

item.title: Google Maps Places API
item.description: Turns search terms like 'dentists in Austin, TX' into Google Maps places with name, address, phone, website, rating, review count, categories, coordinates and opening hours as JSON. Apify Actor with a free monthly credit and usage-based pricing; callable from MCP clients.

item.title: LinkedIn Jobs API
item.description: Searches public LinkedIn job listings by keyword, location, seniority and job type, or fetches specific job URLs, and returns title, company, location, salary when listed and the full description as JSON. Apify Actor with a free monthly credit and usage-based pricing; callable from MCP clients.

item.title: LinkedIn Profile API
item.description: Takes public LinkedIn profile URLs and returns name, headline, location, current company, experience, education and follower count as JSON, with no login or cookies. Apify Actor with a free monthly credit and usage-based pricing; callable from MCP clients.

item.title: YouTube Transcript & Subtitles API
item.description: Returns YouTube transcripts, subtitles and captions as text, SRT or VTT, with video metadata. Works on single videos, lists of URLs or a whole channel, and runs from servers where YouTube blocks direct caption requests. Apify Actor with a free monthly credit and usage-based pricing; callable from MCP clients.

item.title: 1ZheAI
item.description: Independent paid AI API gateway for developers using Claude, GPT and image models through documented Anthropic-format and OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Requires an account, API key and funded balance. Model-specific pricing and usage records. Claude cache use is billed at the official rate; non-Claude-Code requests include an additional system prompt. Independent service, not an official model-provider partner.

item.title: Fondo Blanco
item.description: Free Spanish tool to remove photo backgrounds and put a white background (quitar fondo / fondo blanco).

item.title: Kepo
item.description: Mac desktop widgets for macOS: clocks, calendars, notes, RSS and system widgets on the desktop.

item.title: ViewHTML
item.description: Online HTML viewer and live HTML preview — paste markup and see it rendered instantly in the browser.

item.title: Tessamonials
item.description: AI voice/text customer interviews with adaptive follow-ups, transcripts and feedback. Saved testimonials default to approved; participants can unapprove or withdraw. Publication is separate. Free: 15 lifetime voice or text interviews per Company, counted at three answers or over two minutes. Short visits and member tests excluded. Paid plans available. Docs: https://tessamonials.com/docs/mcp. Official icon: https://tessamonials.com/images/favicon-48.png?v=2

item.title: EchoEmpire Machine Foundry
item.description: Machine-readable catalog of EchoEmpire's pay-per-event Apify Actors for AI agents: YouTube transcripts and comments, contact details, LinkedIn and remote jobs, PDF/OCR/SEC/subtitle citation chunkers. Call via Apify REST or MCP; pay with an Apify token or Apify AGI prepaid token over x402/MPP. Catalog documents endpoints only; it does not execute or bill.

item.title: Nab
item.description: Phone, SMS and email tools for AI agents, with owner-granted permissions and approvals for sensitive actions. Nab is an early beta with web and iOS access. Tool use requires paid activation; availability depends on country and provider. Developer guide: https://heynab.com/developers. Sign up: https://heynab.com/login.

item.title: VoxSail
item.description: Browser-based video and audio localization for creators, educators, and teams. Transcribe and translate subtitles, generate AI dubbing, review results in an online editor, and export localized media, transcripts, or SRT/ASS subtitle files. Paid subscriptions and credit add-ons, with one-time starter credits. Company: Hefei Qiangshi Information Technology Co., Ltd.

item.title: AI Tiny Desk
item.description: Create a personal 19-second vertical desk-concert video from one adult photo, with a BGM version for social sharing. Personalized creation uses paid one-time credits from $9.99; examples are free to view. AI can alter likeness and movement.

item.title: Day of the Dead Pet AI
item.description: Turn a dog or cat photo into a 10-second vertical pet tribute video with marigold bridge, gate, ofrenda and rainbow bridge scenes.

item.title: Friday Invoice Chase Ranker
item.description: Rank which unpaid freelance invoices to chase this Friday by amount × days overdue. Free browser tool for freelancers prioritizing chase order.

item.title: Marigold Bridge AI
item.description: Turn one adult portrait into a vertical remembrance video with an animated marigold walk or petal transformation. Personalized creation uses paid one-time credits from $9.99; examples are free to view. AI can alter likeness and movement.

item.title: Melso fiscal MCP
item.description: OAuth-protected hosted MCP for Spanish invoices, income, expenses and tax calendars in Melso. Customers authorize company access; tools can record expenses and prepare invoice work within granted permissions. The paid Spanish fiscal service combines a personal AI agent with human tax professionals. Tax-return approval and filing remain in Melso. Proprietary hosted service; no public implementation repository.

item.title: Ozil Goal
item.description: A browser-based AI creator for personal 15-second football goal videos from one adult photo. Paid one-time credits from $5.99. 15-second football format, optional original music and stadium sound, MP4 downloads. Independent product with no player or club endorsement.

item.title: AEGIS by 100monkeys.ai
item.description: AEGIS by 100monkeys.ai, in beta, is a self-hosted orchestrator that runs autonomous agents in isolated, policy-enforced runtimes with durable FSM state. It enforces isolation and policy on every tool call, and each run is a durable state machine. Free and open source under AGPL-3.0, written in Rust; source at github.com/100monkeys-ai/aegis-orchestrator. Install: curl -fsSL https://get.100monkeys.ai | bash. We build AEGIS at 100monkeys.ai.

item.title: Carbon Forge
item.description: Carbon Forge is source control and a shared record for people and AI agents. Code, files and prose live in one record on the server, read and written through the same tools over MCP. An agent opens a lane, a set of patches over the trunk, instead of cloning; each landing is one all-or-nothing changeset; blame, grep and history run on the server; git is a projection pushed to GitHub. Public workspaces read over MCP without a token. We build Carbon Forge at 100monkeys.ai.

item.title: Repostit
item.description: Social publishing and content repurposing for creators and marketing teams. Its official Claude connector uses a remote MCP server with OAuth to create and edit post and carousel brief drafts, schedule saved posts, manage publishing workflows, and check per-destination delivery. Account, plan limits, and platform requirements apply. Paid plans include a 14-day trial; no card required.

item.title: ToolsPad MCP
item.description: Remote MCP connection for small businesses, agencies and consultants to work with contacts, tasks, notes, forms and appointments in one ToolsPad workspace. OAuth authorises access; read/write is the default, a read-only option is available, and access can be revoked in Settings.
